messages:
jamie: Heads up — post-merge infra PR includes a route-table change + IAM role rename. Targeting tonight's 00:30 UTC change window. Need preflight (plan + smoke), rollback ladder, and a short version freeze. @sara-oncall can you own coordination?

noor: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4823. Plan summary looks small: 1 route replacement, 1 iam_role rename. plan snippet:
```
# terraform plan summary
~ module.network.aws_route.app_egress (replace)
~ module.iam.aws_iam_role.worker_role (update - rename)
Plan: 0 to add, 2 to change, 0 to destroy.
```

deploybot: terraform plan started by jamie — id: plan-3281234567. Plan artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/plans/plan-3281234567.tfout

ben: Quick asks: can we pin provider+module versions in this PR before apply? Recommend provider aws 4.45.0 and module.network@v1.9 -> v1.9.1 (no breaking changes). Also prefer `terraform apply -out=plan.tfout` + `terraform apply plan.tfout` (no refresh during apply).

jamie: Proposed rollback ladder (brief):
R1 — Route quick-replace: run targeted apply to restore previous route resource only (`-target=module.network.aws_route.app_egress`) -> expected 5m. Owned: noor.
R2 — IAM rename rollback: re-deploy module tag v1.8 for IAM module (apply module only) -> expected 10–15m. Owned: ben.
R3 — Full infra revert: git revert PR commit (7a9f) + reapply main -> expected 20–45m. Owned: jamie.
R4 — Emergency regional failover: trigger cross-region traffic shift + evacuate pods (runbook link below) -> >45m, exec team escalation.

jamie: Abort criteria (simple):
- >0.5% climb in 5xx rate sustained for 5m
- p95 latency increases by >=200ms for 5m
- Any data-plane auth failures observed in metrics or logs
If any criterion met, start R1 immediately, escalate to R2 within 10m if not resolved.

sara-oncall: I'm oncall 00:00–01:00 UTC. I'll run preflight smoke from probe box and verify dashboards after apply. I'll post checks: `curl -sS https://health.redwood.internal/ready` and a simple query to the metrics dashboard. If anything suspicious, I'll ping @ben and @jamie and initiate R1.

noor: Preflight checklist I'm adding to PR description:
1) Plan artifact present (s3 link)
2) Diff snippet + `terraform plan` output screenshot
3) Smoke tests from probe (success)
4) Module/provider pins committed to main (version-freeze commit)
5) Rollback ladder steps + owners listed

jamie: Deploy notes: we'll use deploybot staged rollout: `deploybot apply --plan s3://redwood-artifacts/plans/plan-3281234567.tfout --staged 50%:10m -> 100%` (manual step-up). Do NOT staged-apply if plan shows >3 resource replacements.

deploybot: plan validation OK. Replacements count = 1. Approval present from oncall (sara-oncall). Ready to schedule apply at 00:31 UTC on jamie's signal.

ben: Post-apply checks (automation):
- `aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=tag:Name,Values=app-rt` diff to expected
- `aws iam get-role --role-name worker-role` ensure correct ARN and assume-role policy
- quick traffic test hitting canary endpoints and checking 200s
If any mismatch, run R1.

jamie: I'll push a version-freeze commit now to pin modules/providers and add a one-line release note to CHANGELOG: "version-freeze: pin provider aws and network module for 00:30 apply". We'll lift freeze after 30m stable post-apply.

noor: Added rollback ladder and thresholds into the PR description and updated the infra runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/infra-rollback-ladder

sara-oncall: I'll be watching dashboards and will post back status at +5m, +15m, +30m after apply. If stable at +30m we'll shout-lift freeze.

jamie: Thanks everyone. I'll coordinate final green-light 00:31 UTC. :thumbsup:
